WARNING: Server selection applies only to rooms you create. Joining an existing room connects you to that room's server.

Hosting your own server takes only a few steps.

First, open port 8690. Players cannot connect to your server while that port stays closed. 

You can check the port at "[url=https://www.yougetsignal.com/tools/open-ports/]https://www.yougetsignal.com/tools/open-ports/[/url]" once the server is running.

Second, you need a stable PC and a stable internet connection. There are no strict minimum specs. The person with the most powerful hardware in the group is the best candidate to host.

Remember to allow port 8690 through your firewall. It often blocks traffic before it reaches your router.

The process is very similar to hosting a Minecraft server. Anyone who has done that will run this one without trouble.
